evidenceRules.CONFIRMED: Supported by current official documentation or current official repository documentation.
evidenceRules.VENDOR CLAIM: A vendor-published performance, accuracy, adoption, or superiority statement not independently reproduced here.
evidenceRules.INFERRED: A bounded deduction from documented product/library shape, not an explicit capability statement.
evidenceRules.NOT VERIFIED: Current evidence was insufficient; absence is not claimed.

secondaryContext.finding: Managed rule, ML, and provider workflows, normalization, confidence scores, S3 outputs, encryption, and run history; it is a cloud platform substitute, not a reviewer-workbench comparison.
Active labeling/training, probabilistic and deterministic matching, custom blocking, model documentation, and enterprise explanations make it a serious engine/platform reference.
Mature merge, unmerge, crosswalk, relationship, and survivorship behavior demonstrates why Samewise should not position against full MDM.
Trust-based cell survivorship, manual merge, audit tables, and APIs are mature MDM capabilities outside Samewise's narrow scope.
